rows: - GitHub starts scheduled workflows hours late in this private repo (the Tailscale watch `0 6 * * 1` fired at 14:20, 12:01 and 12:12 UTC on its last three Mondays; the Nx audit `17 3 * * 1` at 09:03; the ten-minute Gem cron produced no run in 63 minutes after it reached `main`), so the owner had every `schedule` trigger removed: `repomix-gemini-context.yml`, `cold-ci.yml`, `nx-cache-audit.yml`, `tailscale-auth-key-expiry.yml`, `ci-budget.yml`. The workflows keep `workflow_dispatch` (the Gem sync: the tagged empty commit). `ci-budget.yml`'s dispatch now takes a true/false value, because the monthly reset was its only way to set the flag back to false.
